proposal.summary: Batch Q4 is CM550's remaining placeholders in 0x0-0xffff and 0x20000-0x2dfff. They fall into a few groups: the J1939 engine data module (EEC2 empty step, friction percent torque, torque curve point 3, reference fueling and torque); the PGN 61184 memory read services and their registration; and the governors (ASG reference speed sets, droop fueling, the variable speed governor and pedal fault selectors of the user fueling state chain, the LSG integrator preset and the cold idle speed). The rest are no load fuel, the ANC timing limit, the engine position phase lag, J1708/J1587 (PID 243 reply, memory write records), the power-down EEPROM save, two empty speed-interrupt steps and small start-up steps. Ten are step-by-step twins of CM848 functions and take shared unprefixed names: the five read handlers and their registration, the EEC2 empty step, the torque curve point 3 setter, the reference fueling and torque initializer, and the PTO throttle override initializer. Ten are counterparts (same role, different code) and nine have no CM848 match. 0x2cf52 is skipped: nothing in the dumped ROM calls it or reads its destination. The vp44_ prefix was wrong on all three vp44_ rows: 0xfa68 is J1939 torque curve code, 0x25a34 the LSG integrator preset, 0x27c20 the power-down EEPROM save.

functions.role: Every 50 ms computes the acceleration noise control (ANC) timing advance limit NZTALM: a table lookup by engine speed while its conditions hold, else a ramp back up to 1024.
functions.discriminator: Of the three ANC siblings it is the timing one: it tests the timing enable bit 0x2000, uses a coolant temperature threshold where the fuel (0xb2aa) and speed (0xb4f2) siblings use engine speed, looks up the NZTALMXA/NZTALMYA table and ramps out to 1024 by the timing increment; cm550_applyAccelerationNoiseControlTimingLimit consumes its output.
functions.plate_comment: Acceleration noise control (ANC) timing limit, every 50 ms from cm550_runEvery10FramesTaskSetPhase1 while algorithm_enable_flags_3_cal.acceleration_noise_control_timing_limit_enable is set. A first stage filtered acceleration (e2m 10A4 +8 ESFT01AC) above the timing threshold sets the inhibit NZTALMIH (10A4 +18) for NZTAIHTM passes (timer 0x800040). With ASANENF set, no inhibit, the coolant above its threshold, ESFT01AC at or below and ESFT02AC at or above their limits (or the override ASANODFG) the status NZTALMSS (10A4 +E) is held for a minimum time (timer 0x800044); while it is 1 NZTALM (10A4 +2) = the ANC timing table at current_engine_rpm_filtered, else NZTALM ramps up by the timing increment to 1024. cm550_applyAccelerationNoiseControlTimingLimit applies it; CM848 compiles this stage out (cm848_passCompensatedTimingToCombustionLimits).

Siblings: 0xb2aa uses acceleration_noise_control_fuel_limit_enable, an engine speed threshold and caps at fuel_demand_maximum; 0xb4f2 sets anc_speed_limit_ramp_value. Only caller cm550_runEvery10FramesTaskSetPhase1. CM848: e2m 10A4 is in CHR (ANC_Timing etc. at 0x40a04a, unread) and cm848_passCompensatedTimingToCombustionLimits 0x17b54 only copies the timing ('compiled out').

functions.role: Start-up: points the four all speed governor reference speed pointers at the set 1 and set 2 reference speeds for 0 and 100 percent throttle, and presets the set selection from its default.
functions.discriminator: The only writer of the four pointers 0x80a9ac-0x80a9b8 (0xd2be only reads them) and the start-up preset of asg_throttle_source_selector (ASDPFG).
functions.plate_comment: Start-up initializer of the all speed governor (ASG) reference speed sets (one call from mc68k_applicationMain). 0x80a9ac / 0x80a9b0 point at set 1 (e2m 0008 +20 ASMNRF and +22 ASMXRF, the reference speeds for 0 and 100 percent throttle) and 0x80a9b4 / 0x80a9b8 at set 2 (0008 +2E ASMNRF02 and +30 ASMXRF02). asg_throttle_source_selector (107A +16 ASDPFG) = default_throttle_source_selector (1387 +8 ASDPFGTN). 0xd2be then copies the selected set (0 = set 1, 1 = set 2) into ASMNRP / ASMXRP and interpolates the throttle reference. CM848 blends its two sets instead (cm848_blendAllSpeedGovernorReferenceSpeeds) and its start-up step cm848_initializeAllSpeedGovernorTuningSetBlendWeight only copies the same 1387 +8 default.

CM848 e2m 0008 +20 / +22 / +2E / +30 = all_speed_governor_minimum/maximum_reference_speed_1/2_cal; 1387 +8 = all_speed_governor_tuning_set_default_blend_weight_cal, copied by CM848 0x2c100 (one call from cm848_applicationMain).

functions.role: Updates the selected throttle control flag STUOTHGV near no-load fueling. When no user fueling state is selected and the flag is 1, it selects FUELING_STATE_VARIABLE_SPEED_GOVERNOR and loads the throttle mode governor gains.
functions.discriminator: In the user fueling state chain 0x3458c it is the selector of state 7 (0x25806 selects state 6). It alone updates STUOTHGV, from FSTHGVOP, the switched throttle control governor bit and the interlock switch.
functions.plate_comment: Variable speed governor selection, called by the user fueling state chain 0x3458c with the previous user fueling state. While final_fueling is below no_load_fuel_quantity + ASSDFUOF (e2m 107D +A) and the throttle is 0 it sets STUOTHGV (107C +16) = FSTHGVOP (0008 +54), inverted while algorithm_enable_flags_27_cal.switched_throttle_control_governor_select and the interlock switch bit are both set. If user_fueling_state is FUELING_STATE_NOT_SELECTED and STUOTHGV is 1 it selects FUELING_STATE_VARIABLE_SPEED_GOVERNOR and calls 0xd3e6. Unless the previous state was 7 or 3 it also loads the throttle mode gain set (107B), clears the external reset flag and loads the throttle mode fueling limits and the reference filter coefficient. CM848 splits this into cm848_updateVariableSpeedGovernorSelection (the flag) and cm848_selectVariableSpeedGovernorMode (the state).
functions.evidence: ROM 0xd4c2-0xd4de: NLFL 0x80db1c + ASSDFUOF 0x807ac8 compared with FSFNFL 0x80d32e (ble skips, so the update happens only while FSFNFL < the sum); 0xd4e0 tst.w 0x80aa82; 0xd4e8 0x803cca & 8; 0xd4f6 0x80bcd1 & 2; 0xd510-0xd52c STUOTHGV 0x80a982 = 0x803bf0 or its inverse. 0xd532-0xd53c: tst.w 0x80ded4, cmpi.w #1,(0x80a982), move.w #7 -> 0x80ded4; bsr 0xd3e6; 0xd544 / 0xd54a previous != 7 and != 3; 0xd550-0xd574 0x80a9a8 = #0x807be0, clr.w 0x80a9a0, 0x80a99e = 0x807bde, 0x80a99c = 0x807bdc, 0x80a984 = #0x807bda. Chain position matches CM848: cm848_resetEngineOperatingMode calls the pedal fault selector then cm848_selectVariableSpeedGovernorMode, as CM550 0x3458c calls 0x25806 then 0xd4ae. The code differs: CM848 0x2c6c4 tests final_fueling <= the sum (inclusive) and switch_input_state_bits.unwired_switch, and CM848 0x10110 also blends the sets, computes the throttle reference and compensator coefficients, loads 10 selected gains, and tests only previous != 7. Dump: FSTHGVOP 1, STUOTHGV 1.

functions.role: Returns the all speed governor droop line fueling: the ASG no-load fuel + (ASG reference speed - engine speed) x 9813 / (8 x droop slope), limited to 0..0x1700.
functions.discriminator: The only function that refreshes the droop snapshot 0x800180 (from ASSLDP while ASRFST is 7) and turns the ASG speed error into droop line fueling. Only 0xf796, the J1939 driver's demand torque, uses it.
functions.plate_comment: All speed governor droop line fueling for the J1939 driver's demand torque. While all_speed_governor_reference_state (e2m 107A +2 ASRFST) is 7 it refreshes the droop snapshot 0x800180 from the selected droop slope (107A +E ASSLDP). With a zero snapshot it returns 0x1700 while the ASG reference speed (107A +0 ASTHRFES) is above engine_rpm_primary and 0 otherwise. Otherwise it returns (ASTHRFES - engine_rpm_primary) x 9813 / (snapshot x 8) + the ASG no-load fuel (1322 +0 ASNLFL), limited to 0..0x1700. Its caller 0xf796 uses it when FSTHGVOP (0008 +54) is 1. CM848 computes the same droop line inside cm848_calculateEffectiveFuelLimit, together with the speed limiter and the fuel limits.
functions.evidence: ROM 0xf718 movea.l #0x800180,a0; 0xf71e d2 = 0x80a98c - 0x80ccf6; 0xf72a cmpi.w #7,(0x80a98e) / move.w 0x80a99a,(a0); 0xf73a tst.w (a0): 0 or #0x1700 by the sign of d2; 0xf750-0xf766 ext.l / mulu.l #0x2655 / divs.l by (snapshot << 3); 0xf76e add 0x8091de; 0xf776-0xf790 clamp 0..0x1700. Caller cm550_paramSystemModeController 0xf796 (when _DAT_00803bf0 == 1), itself called by sendPgn61444ElectronicEngineController1Message. CM848 0x20554 refreshes all_speed_governor_droop_snapshot only in mode 7 and forms (reference - speed) x 9813 (li r10,9813) / (droop << 3) + all_speed_governor_no_load_fuel. It also has deadband and minimum-droop branches and applies six fuel limits and the speed limiter, so it is a counterpart, not a twin.

functions.role: Computes the J1939 nominal friction percent torque x 256 (SPN 514, e2m 1102 +6 JCINFCTQ) for the EEC3 broadcast.
functions.discriminator: The only writer of JCINFCTQ 0x80da1c. It scales no_load_fuel_quantity (not final fueling or a torque curve point) against the determined peak fueling.
functions.plate_comment: Nominal friction percent torque for EEC3 (PGN 65247 byte 1, SPN 514), called first by the EEC3 builder 0x330c4. JCINFCTQ (e2m 1102 +6, 0x80da1c, 1/256 percent) = (no_load_fuel_quantity - the maximum fueling that injects no fuel 0x808194) x 25600 / (determined_peak_engine_fueling_0_100 - 0x808194). It is 0 when either difference is not positive and capped at 32000 (125 percent). Counterpart of CM848 cm848_calculateNominalFrictionPercentTorque, whose floor tests compare with -32000 and store -32000 instead of 0.
functions.evidence: ROM 0xf9ae-0xf9be: d2 = 0x80db1c - 0x808194 (long); <= 0 -> clr.w 0x80da1c. 0xf9c6-0xf9d2: d3 = 0x80da32 - 0x808194; <= 0 -> clr. 0xf9da-0xf9e6: d2 x 25600 by shifts and adds; jsr 0x165f2 (divide); 0xf9f4 store; 0xf9f6 cmpi.w #0x7d00 / bls / move.w #0x7d00. functions.role: Sets torque curve point 1 (through 0xfa06), then point 3 of the J1939 engine configuration torque curve: point 1's speed and fueling when point 3's speed is below point 1's, else the calibrated point 3 speed and derated fueling.
functions.discriminator: Of the torque curve case helpers it alone sets point 3 after calling the point 1 helper. The torque curve builder 0xfb26 calls it only in cases 6 and 7.
functions.plate_comment: Runs the point 1 helper 0xfa06, then sets point 3 of the J1939 engine configuration (PGN 65251) torque curve. When the point 3 speed (e2m 1102 +26 JCTQRPP3) is below the point 1 speed (+22 JCTQRPP1), point 3 takes point 1's speed and fueling (+2C into +30). Otherwise speed = j1939_engine_speed_at_point_3 (1104 +4 JC39P3RP) and fueling = 1104 +C JCDQFLP3. The torque curve builder 0xfb26 calls it in its cases 6 and 7. Twin of CM848 0x20bfc (one shared name); it is not VP44 code.

CM848 0x20bfc-0x20c60: bl 0x20b84; lhz 0x40adac (point 1) and 0x40adb0 (point 3); cmpw / blt -> sth point 1 speed and 0x40adb6 -> 0x40adba; else ROM 0x5c34c / 0x5c354 (1104 +4 / +C). Same steps in the same order on the same e2m records (CM550 e2m: 0x80da38 1102 +22, 0x80da3c +26, 0x80da42 +2C, 0x80da46 +30, 0x808162 1104 +4, 0x80816a 1104 +C). functions.role: When the low speed governor takes control, presets its integrator between LSMNITPZ and LSMXITPZ for a bumpless transfer and seeds its previous-pass values.
functions.discriminator: Called only on the LSG takeover (adjusted state LSG, final state not LSG). It is the only writer of LSMXITPZ and of the integrator preset; the LSG itself updates the integrator every pass.
functions.plate_comment: Low speed governor integrator preset, called by cm550_runLowSpeedGovernor when adjusted_user_fueling_state is FUELING_STATE_LOW_SPEED_GOVERNOR and final_fueling_state is not. It refreshes the 100 percent throttle 4D fueling at the LSG adjusted reference speed (0x2595a, into 0x801a6e) and sets LSMXITPZ (e2m 1065 +E) = that + LSMXPZOF (1064 +4), limited to 0..0x1700. It presets the 16.16 integrator 0x801a6a to final_fueling - LSER x LSPPGN / 960 + engine_rpm_primary x LSPP02GN / 2226 (minus no_load_fuel_quantity with low_speed_governor_no_load_fuel_enable), limited to LSMNITPZ (1064 +6) .. LSMXITPZ. Then LSFL = final_fueling, LSDVFL = 0, and the engine speed and both proportional gains are stored as the previous-pass values. Counterpart of CM848 cm848_presetLowSpeedGovernorIntegrator, which has no engine speed term, an optional reuse of the previous integral and a park or neutral minimum.

functions.role: Every 100 ms computes the cold idle LSG reference speed LSCIRF from the coolant temperature and a cold idle timer, ramps it out, and raises the operator adjusted LSG breakpoint speed to it.
functions.discriminator: The only writer of LSCIRF and of the cold idle timer, and the only user of the 1066 cold idle records.
functions.plate_comment: Cold idle speed of the low speed governor, every 100 ms (cm550_runEvery20FramesTaskSetPhase4). Cold means the coolant is below LSCICLTP (e2m 1066 +0). With the engine stopped the cold idle timer 0x801a84 is cleared and LSCIRF (1067 +2 'COLD IDLE LSG REFERENCE SPEED') = LSCIRFSR (1066 +2) when cold, else 0. After cranking the timer counts while cold up to LSCITMLM (1066 +4); while running, once the time is up or the engine is warm, LSCIRF ramps down by LSCIRMRT (1066 +6) to 0. LSDSRFRP (1049 +4, the operator adjusted LSG breakpoint speed) is raised to LSCIRF unless low_speed_governor_cold_idle_override_enable and LSCIOD (1049 +6) are both set. Counterpart of CM848 cm848_calculateLowSpeedGovernorCoolantTemperatureSpeed (a coolant table, hot idle and park or neutral design with its records in e2m 14EE).

functions.role: Every 20 ms computes the engine position phase lags (normal ESPG and pulse 0 ESPS00PG) as straight lines in the average engine speed, plus the cam wheel TDC adjustment.

Otherwise it builds the same bytes at 0x801ade and sends them through cm550_insiteMultiFrameResponseBuilder(0xe, 0xf) frame by frame (cm550_insiteMultiFrameContinuation, cm550_responseBufferFinalize at the last frame). functions.role: At power down queues the EEPROM image 0x804156-0x804f91 into the EEPROM write queue in 16-byte chunks, waiting for each, and restarts when the key line returns.
functions.discriminator: The only writer of the upper EEPROM image area (0x804156 up); cm550_commitEepromMirrorToEeprom writes 0x803b0a-0x804155 on a tool request. It alone polls the chip select 2 input bit 0 while waiting and calls restartOnKeyOnDuringPowerDown.
functions.plate_comment: Power-down EEPROM save, called by mc68k_runPowerDownSequence right after its 1000-pass queue drain. From 0x804156 it queues 16-byte chunks (the last partial chunk gets (0x804f92 - pointer) / 2 bytes) through cm550_parameterCircularBufferWrite; two refusals in a row end it. After each chunk it waits up to 16000 x 500 ticks (mc68k_delayTimeBaseTicksWithWatchdogService) for cm550_circularBufferEmptyCheck. If bit 0 of the chip select 2 device input 0xffd000 stays set for more than 80 waits it calls restartOnKeyOnDuringPowerDown. Counterpart of CM848 cm848_saveEepromForPowerDown (same place in the sequence, same 80-sample key test; a mirror save state machine and extra checksum and sequence writes there).

CM848 0x539a78 runs cm848_startEepromMirrorSave and waits while the key line (mios_mdasm30.SCR bit 15) count goes above 0x50, sets key_on_during_power_down_save_flag and restarts after the save, then writes the retry total, checksum and sequence number: different code. Not VP44.

functions.role: Applies the parsed J1708 memory write records: EEPROM and authorization-required records go into the secure write scratch pad (directory entry + data); other records are copied at once. It returns 14 when the scratch pad lacks room.
functions.discriminator: The only writer of the scratch pad directory and data from a J1708 write request. Its caller cm550_diagnosticMemoryWriteHandler only parses the request into the 0x80db68 records.
functions.plate_comment: Second half of the J1708 memory write (called by cm550_diagnosticMemoryWriteHandler with the record count; the caller queues the result). The 10-byte records at 0x80db68 hold the address, a data pointer into the J1708 receive ring, the length and the MEMORY_REGION_TYPE. Records of type MEMORY_REGION_TYPE_EEPROM (5) or MEMORY_REGION_TYPE_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED (3) need scratch pad room: at most 10 directory entries (number_of_entries_in_the_scratch_pad_0_10) and their bytes before scratch_pad_directory_table, else it returns 14 and writes nothing. Each such record gets a 6-byte directory entry (address, length) and its data at scratch_pad_write_pointer; the other records are copied straight to their address. It returns 0 (the source steps its low byte, so copies wrap in the 256-byte receive ring). CM848 has no J1708 and no scratch pad.

Pass 2 0x2cffc-0x2d08e: type 5 / 3 -> move.l a3 to 0x80dd86 + 6n, move.w length to 0x80dd8a + 6n, addq.w #1,(0x80de2c), bytes via (0x80ddc2)+; other types -> move.b to (a3)+. addq.b #1,(-1,a6) steps the low byte of the source. clr.b d0 = 0. - Cal audit: 0x803d5a default_throttle_source_selector (1387 +8) and 0x803f40 maximum_rated_engine_speed_0_5000 (1262 +0) lie in the EEPROM image without _cal. CM848's names for them are all_speed_governor_tuning_set_default_blend_weight_cal and engine_speed_limit_default_cal.
- ANC siblings: 0x80003c and 0x80003e (no rows) are the inhibit timers of 0xb4f2 and 0xb2aa. 0x800042 anc_fuel_limit_active_timer and 0x800046 anc_speed_limit_hold_timer have undefined type (word). The old names of 0xb2aa (cm550_rpm_system_state_controller) and 0xb4f2 (cm550_engineStateFuelLimitInterpolator) are wrong: they are the ANC fuel and engine speed limits.
- 0x2cf52's destination 0x801afc and its neighbours 0x801afa / 0x801afe carry old unproven names. The caller is probably in the undumped 0x40000+ region.

roles.role: Calculates the acceleration noise control (ANC) timing limit, gated by algorithm_enable_flags_3_cal bit 0x2000. A bare-engine latch (ESFT01AC 0x80a294 > NZTAACTR 0x807a50) sets NZTALMIH 0x80a2a4 and reloads the countdown 0x800040 with NZTAIHTM. While ASANENF is set, the latch is clear, coolant 0x80a336 > NZTACLTR, ESFT01AC <= NZTAACTR and ESFT02AC >= NZTAFTTR (or while the ASANODFG override is set), NZTALMSS 0x80a29a = 1 and the hold timer 0x800044 = NZTADYTM. While NZTALMSS is 1, NZTALM 0x80a28e = the engine speed table (record 0x800058 at current_engine_rpm_filtered). Otherwise NZTALM ramps up by NZTARMRT and stops at 1024. The decompiled word return is a leftover d0, so the function is void.
roles.discriminator: Its siblings 0xb2aa (fuel limit) and 0xb4f2 (engine speed limit) use the same skeleton. Only this one has enable bit 0x2000, a coolant temperature gate (the siblings gate on engine speed) and the NZTALM output with a 1024 ceiling. cm550_applyAccelerationNoiseControlTimingLimit (0xb4ce) applies that output. Caller: cm550_runEvery10FramesTaskSetPhase1 (0x1b6c8).
roles.cm848_counterpart: none: CM848's ANC timing stage is compiled out. The CHR e2m places 10A4 ANC_Timing / Status / Inhibit at 0x40a04a-0x40a04e, but no CM848 code accesses them. cm848_passCompensatedTimingToCombustionLimits @ 0x17b54 marks the place.

roles.role: A single rts. It is called only from the tail of all four modes of the TPU channel 10 primary engine speed interrupt handler (0x19acc / 0x19e90 / 0x1a52c / 0x1a8a4): after cm550_rpmTimingDeltaComparatorWithReturn, before mc68k_FUN_0001266e and the clear of TPU_CISR bit 10.
roles.discriminator: An empty body: the only thing that sets it apart is the call site. The channel 10 (primary speed) handlers call this stub, the channel 1 (backup speed) handlers call 0xc87e.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none found: I checked the callers of every cm848_emptyStub*, and no CM848 engine speed interrupt calls an empty stub.

roles.role: A single rts. It is called only at the end of the three TPU channel 1 (backup speed) interrupt handlers mc68k_dutyCycleMonitorIsrHandler 0x1af32, mc68k_FUN_0001b30a and mc68k_FUN_0001b4b2, after mc68k_resetSpeedMeasurementMode0 and before the clear of TPU_CISR bit 1.
roles.discriminator: An empty body. It differs from 0xc87c only by its callers, the channel 1 handlers.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none found (same check as 0xc87c).

roles.role: Start-up initializer of speed_request_blend_weight_by_speed_difference_lookup (0x800102). It sets x_axis_offset = 2, the x axis pointer = 0x807acc (e2m 1326 ASTHPFXA) and the y values pointer = 0x807ad8 (1327 ASTHPFYA). It has one jsr, from mc68k_applicationMain's start-up list (step 0x8876).
roles.discriminator: It is the only writer of that record's size and pointers. The record's only other user is 0xc8a0, which writes x_input and runs the lookup.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none: cm848_calculateGovernorReferenceSpeedBlend @ 0xe8dc passes the same tables (0x5c272 / 0x5c27e) straight to lookupTableInterpolation, so CM848 has no start-up step for them.

roles.role: Start-up step, jsr from mc68k_applicationMain step 0x8726. It stores four pointers to the all-speed governor reference speeds: 0x80a9ac = 0x803bbc (ASMNRF, set 1 0 % throttle), 0x80a9b0 = 0x803bbe (ASMXRF), 0x80a9b4 = 0x803bca (ASMNRF02, set 2) and 0x80a9b8 = 0x803bcc (ASMXRF02). It then copies the trim ASDPFGTN (0x803d5a) into the droop / set selection flag ASDPFG (0x80a9a2).
roles.discriminator: It is the only writer of the four pointers. Their only reader is 0xd2be (misnamed cm550_acceleratorThrottleFaultDetector), which loads ASMNRP / ASMXRP from pair 1 when ASDPFG = 0 and from pair 2 when ASDPFG = 1. The RAM dump holds these pointers, ASDPFGTN = ASDPFG = 1, and ASMNRP / ASMXRP equal ASMNRF02 / ASMXRF02.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_initializeAllSpeedGovernorTuningSetBlendWeight @ 0x2c100, counterpart: it only copies ASDPFGTN into ASDPFG. CM848 blends the two sets with a 0..128 weight and keeps no pointers.

roles.role: Variable speed governor mode selector, the 6th selector of cm550_engine_protection_coordinator. First, at no load (final_fueling < no_load_fuel_quantity + ASSDFUOF 0x807ac8) and with zero commanded throttle, it sets STUOTHGV 0x80a982 = FSTHGVOP 0x803bf0, inverted when algorithm_enable_flags_27_cal bit 3 and bit 1 of 0x80bcd1 are both set. Then, if no user fueling state has been claimed and STUOTHGV = 1, it claims FUELING_STATE_VARIABLE_SPEED_GOVERNOR and runs 0xd3e6. When the previous state was neither 7 nor 3, it also loads the throttle-mode gain set (0x807be0), clears the external reset, and sets ASCNLOLM / ASCNHILM and the ASFTCF filter coefficient.
roles.discriminator: It claims state 7 and is the only writer of STUOTHGV. Its sibling 0x25806, which runs just before it, claims state 6.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_selectVariableSpeedGovernorMode @ 0x10110 plus cm848_updateVariableSpeedGovernorSelection @ 0x2c6c4, counterpart. It has the same slot in cm848_resetEngineOperatingMode and the same flag logic, but CM848 keeps the flag update in a separate function. CM848 also blends the reference speeds, computes the throttle reference and compensator coefficients, copies ten gains, and tests only prev != 7.

roles.role: Returns the fueling on the all-speed governor droop line at the throttle reference speed: (ASTHRFES 0x80a98c - ENGRPM 0x80ccf6) x 9813 / (droop x 8) + ASNLFL 0x8091de, clamped to 0..5888 (400 mm3). The droop word 0x800180 is refreshed from ASSLDP 0x80a99a only while ASRFST 0x80a98e is 7. With a droop of 0 it returns 5888 when the reference is above the engine speed, otherwise 0.
roles.discriminator: It is the only user of 0x800180 and has one caller, 0xf796 (misnamed cm550_paramSystemModeController, the J1939 driver demand fueling selector). That caller uses it as JCDRIDFL when FSTHGVOP = 1, and uses the 4D fueling 5DFL otherwise.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_calculateEffectiveFuelLimit @ 0x20554, counterpart. It is called from the same place: cm848_calculateDriverDemandPercentTorque calls it when variable_speed_governor_default_cal = 1. Its tail is the same droop line, with all_speed_governor_droop_snapshot and all_speed_governor_no_load_fuel. CM848 adds the speed limiter fuel limit, the minimum of six fuel limits, a minimum droop branch and deadband compensation.

roles.role: A single rts. Its only reference is the jsr at 0x330a8 in the PGN 61443 (EEC2) transmit descriptor initializer 0x33064 (misnamed vp44_cumminsProprietaryDM_983_Builder). The call sits after the descriptor stores (CAN ID 0xf00300, 5 bytes) and before the handler registration 0x2f47e(0xf003, 0x32e4c).
roles.discriminator: An empty body, like 0xc87c / 0xc87e / 0x26b82. This is the stub that the EEC2 set-up calls. In ROM it sits between the percent load (0xf930) and nominal friction (0xf99c) calculations of the J1939 torque module.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_emptyStubFunction7 @ 0x20aec, twin by position. It is also one blr, called only by cm848_initPgn61443Eec2Handler @ 0x25d60 at the same point. It sits between cm848_calculateEnginePercentLoadAtCurrentSpeed and cm848_calculateNominalFrictionPercentTorque, in the same source order as CM550. The confidence is high for the twin and low only for the wording of the shared name. A shared 'emptyStubFunction7' would be confusing next to the unrelated cm550_emptyStubFunction7 (0x19aca).

roles.role: Calculates the J1939 nominal friction percent torque (SPN 514): JCINFCTQ 0x80da1c = (no_load_fuel_quantity - CLNTFL 0x808194) x 25600 / (JCRFEGFL 0x80da32 - CLNTFL), using the saturating division 0x165f2 and capping at 32000. The result is 0 when either difference is not positive.
roles.discriminator: It is the only writer of 0x80da1c. Its only caller is the PGN 65247 (EEC3) builder 0x330c4 (misnamed vp44_configParamCanBuilder), which sends the high byte + 125. The other percent calculations in the module (0xf8c6 / 0xf930) divide final_fueling instead.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_calculateNominalFrictionPercentTorque @ 0x20af0, near twin: same steps, the same 25600 / 32000, the same caller position (first call of the EEC3 builder) and the same source order. The floors differ: CM848 floors at -32000 and stores 0x8300, CM550 floors at 0 and stores 0. Strictly that makes it a counterpart, so the name keeps the cm550_ prefix. The writeJ1939DiagnosticMemory precedent would allow the shared name calculateNominalFrictionPercentTorque.

roles.role: Sets J1939 torque curve points 1 and 3 for the derate cases. It calls 0xfa06 (point 1 at the derated idle fueling). Then, if the point 1 speed 0x80da38 is above the point 3 speed 0x80da3c (unsigned compare), point 3 takes point 1's speed and fueling (0x80da42). Otherwise point 3 takes the calibrated speed 0x808162 and fueling 0x80816a.
roles.discriminator: Its caller 0xfb26 (misnamed vp44_fuelLimitExceedanceStatisticsAccumulator, the PGN 65251 torque curve update) calls it only in cases 6 and 7 (a derate with the LSG reference outside its band). Cases 2 and 3 call 0xfa06 alone. It contains no VP44 logic, so the vp44_ prefix is wrong.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_setJ1939TorqueCurvePoints1And3AtDeratedFueling @ 0x20bfc, twin. It calls 0x20b84 (the twin of 0xfa06, with the same /167), makes the same compare on lhz values and the same two stores in each branch. It is called only in cases 6 and 7 of cm848_updateJ1939EngineConfigurationTorqueCurve, and its point 1 setter sits right before it in both ROMs. Both rows take the shared name.

roles.role: Runs while algorithm_enable_flags_18_cal.programmable_power_enable (bit 9) is clear. It copies JCINPKFL 0x80815e (e2m 1104 +0) into JCRFEGFL 0x80da32 (1102 +1C), and JCRFEGTQ 0x808160 (1104 +2) into JCRFTQ 0x80da34 (1102 +1E). The decompiled return is a leftover d0, so the function is void.
roles.discriminator: It is the last call of the shared initializePgn65251EngineConfiguration1Buffer (0x33692) and the only writer of 0x80da32 and 0x80da34.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_initializeJ1939ReferenceEngineFuelingAndTorque @ 0x212dc, twin: the same bit 9 test of flags word 18, the same two copies between the same e2m records, and the same position as the last call of initializePgn65251EngineConfiguration1Buffer @ 0x1b900. Both rows take the shared name.

roles.role: Handler for PGN 61184 service 0x43, registered by pointer from 0x226da. Request bytes 1-2 are the parameter ID and bytes 3-6 the length. It reads from the ID's address at offset 0 through 0x224f4 (cm550_lookupParameterIdAddress, which returns 8 for an unknown ID, then cm550_diagMemoryReadResponseBuilder). The reply is 0x45, or 0x44 below 256 bytes.
roles.discriminator: It takes a 4-byte length and uses offset 0. The 0x46 handler takes a 2-byte offset and a 1-byte length, and the 0x48 handler a 4-byte offset and a 4-byte length. The decompilation drops the arguments of 0x224f4, which has no row.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_handleJ1939ReadByParameterIdLongLengthService @ 0x50c640, twin: the same copies (2 bytes from +1, 4 bytes from +3) and offset 0 (li r5,0), passed to cm848_readJ1939DiagnosticMemoryByParameterId (the twin of 0x224f4). The twin registrar registers it first. Both rows take the shared name.

roles.role: Handler for PGN 61184 service 0x46, registered by pointer from 0x226da. Request bytes 1-2 are the parameter ID, bytes 3-4 a 16-bit offset and byte 5 an 8-bit length; both are zero-extended to longs on the stack. It reads from the ID's address + offset through 0x224f4, and the reply is 0x47.
roles.discriminator: It is the only read handler with a short (2-byte) offset. The decompiled body shows only the ID copy, so the asm (0x2259c-0x225d4) is the evidence for the offset and length bytes.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_handleJ1939ReadByParameterIdShortOffsetService @ 0x50c6a8, twin: it builds the same 0:0:b3:b4 offset and 0:0:0:b5 length words before calling the ID read helper. Both rows take the shared name.

roles.role: Handler for PGN 61184 service 0x48, registered by pointer from 0x226da. Request bytes 1-2 are the parameter ID, bytes 3-6 the offset and bytes 7-10 the length. It reads from the ID's address + offset through 0x224f4, and the reply is 0x49.
roles.discriminator: It is the only read handler with both a 4-byte offset and a 4-byte length.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_handleJ1939ReadByParameterIdLongOffsetService @ 0x50c734, twin: the same three copies (2 bytes from +1, 4 from +3, 4 from +7). Both rows take the shared name.

roles.role: Handler for PGN 61184 service 0x4a, registered by pointer from 0x226da. Request bytes 1-4 are the address and byte 5 the length (zero-extended). It calls cm550_diagMemoryReadResponseBuilder (0x2238e) directly, and the reply is 0x4b.
roles.discriminator: It reads by address with a 1-byte length. Service 0x4c uses a 4-byte length, and the 0x43 / 0x46 / 0x48 handlers read by parameter ID.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_handleJ1939ReadMemoryService @ 0x50c7b0, twin: the same copy and length word, then a call to cm848_readJ1939DiagnosticMemoryAndRespond, the twin of 0x2238e (1764 cap, 0x44 reply rule, reply table). Both rows take the shared name.

roles.role: Handler for PGN 61184 service 0x4c, registered by pointer from 0x226da. Request bytes 1-4 are the address and bytes 5-8 the length. It calls cm550_diagMemoryReadResponseBuilder directly, and the reply is 0x4d.
roles.discriminator: It reads by address with a 4-byte length.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_handleJ1939ReadMemoryLongLengthService @ 0x50c81c, twin. Both rows take the shared name.

roles.role: Registers the five PGN 61184 memory read services with registerJ1939DiagnosticService (0x2ee62): 0x43 to 0x22530, 0x4a to 0x22646, 0x4c to 0x2268e, 0x46 to 0x2257c and 0x48 to 0x225e0. mc68k_initializeJ1939Datalink calls it after cm550_registerJ1939InputMessageHandlers and before the service 0x41 registrar 0x22370 and registerJ1939MemoryWriteServices.
roles.discriminator: It registers the read services. The shared registerJ1939MemoryWriteServices registers the write services 0x44 / 0x45 / 0x4b / 0x4d / 0x47 / 0x49.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_registerJ1939MemoryReadServices @ 0x50c880, twin: the same five services in the same order, through the twin registrar 0x220e4, at the same place in cm848_j1939_system_init. Both rows take the shared name.

roles.role: Two calls and no logic of its own. First cm550_applyLampRequestsToOutputs (0x23a90) copies lamp_driver_output_bitmask into the output image. Then 0x23be8 (misnamed diagnosticMainStateProcessor) compares io_driver_port_1_feedback bits 0-6 with the output image and sets or clears the open / short circuit faults in error words 7 and 8.
roles.discriminator: It is the first call of cm550_runEvery10FramesTaskSetPhase6 (0x1b714, 50 ms) and the only caller of this pair. Lamp sequencing itself is cm550_runLampControl, in slot 5.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none: cm848_runEvery10FramesTaskSetPhase6 @ 0xbd28 calls only cm848_processJ1939AcceleratorInputs. CM848's output read-back check cm848_updateOutputReadBackFaultBits @ 0x53a110 runs in slot 2 and has no lamp request mapping.

roles.role: Accelerator pedal fault (limp home) mode selector, the 5th selector of cm550_engine_protection_coordinator. When LHFLEN 0x80821a (e2m 10CE +C) is set and no state has been claimed, it claims FUELING_STATE_ACCELERATOR_PEDAL_FAULT, and calls presetPedalFaultModeFuelDemand when the previous state was not 6. With algorithm_enable_flags_5_cal.sampled_throttle_override_enable set, the trigger is a J1939 pedal timeout or position error fallback (0x80d70e / 0x80d70c). Otherwise it is error status word 4 bit 1 / 2 / 5, each with its fault_processing_enable_flags[4] bit (faults 65 / 66 = the sampled throttle channel's high / low limits, fault 69 = the throttle mismatch).
roles.discriminator: It claims state 6 and is the only caller of presetPedalFaultModeFuelDemand. The selector after it, 0xd4ae, claims state 7.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_transitionEngineOperatingMode @ 0x50daac, counterpart: the same slot in cm848_resetEngineOperatingMode, the same enable record (pedal_fault_mode_enable_flag = LHFLEN), the same J1939 branch and the shared preset. Its analog test is different: accelerator_pedal_input_fault_flag, or the P2123 / P2122 bits 10 / 11 of fault_detected_cal. The CM848 row has no plate comment, and cm848_selectAcceleratorPedalFaultMode would fit it.

roles.role: Presets the low speed governor integrator when the LSG fueling state is selected but final fueling is not yet LSG. It runs 0x2595a (4D fueling at the LSG adjusted reference speed and 100 % throttle, into 0x801a6e) and sets LSMXITPZ 0x80daec = clamp(LSMXPZOF + that, 0, 5888). It then sets the integrator 0x801a6a = [final_fueling - LSER x LSPPGN / 960 + ENGRPM x LSPP02GN / 2226], minus no_load_fuel_quantity when algorithm_enable_flags_32_cal bit 0x200 is set, clamped to [LSMNITPZ 0x80823c, LSMXITPZ] and shifted left 16. Finally it sets LSFL = final_fueling and LSDVFL = 0, and stores the previous-speed and gain words 0x801a70-0x801a74.
roles.discriminator: cm550_runLowSpeedGovernor calls it only on LSG entry. It is the only reader of LSMNITPZ. It contains no VP44 logic, so the vp44_ prefix is wrong.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_presetLowSpeedGovernorIntegrator @ 0x27e4c, counterpart. It has the same skeleton: the reference maximum fuel, preset maximum = offset + it, the accumulator from final_fueling minus the proportional term, the clamp, the shift left 16 and the cleared terms. Its proportional term includes the gain adjustment, and it has no speed x gain 2 term. It adds a use-previous branch and park / drive minimums.

roles.role: Low speed governor cold idle. While the engine is stopped, LSCIRF 0x80db04 = LSCIRFSR (the cold idle speed) if the coolant is below LSCICLTP, else 0, and the timer 0x801a84 is cleared. Outside cranking the timer counts up to LSCITMLM while the coolant is cold. While running, once the time is up or the coolant is warm, LSCIRF ramps down by LSCIRMRT to 0. On every pass LSDSRFRP 0x80db06 (the operator adjusted LSG breakpoint) is raised to LSCIRF, unless algorithm_enable_flags_12_cal bit 0x4000 and LSCIOD 0x80db08 inhibit it.
roles.discriminator: It is the only user of LSCIRF and of the timer, and it is the code that reads LSCIOD (start-up only clears it). Called second by cm550_runEvery20FramesTaskSetPhase4 (100 ms).
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_calculateLowSpeedGovernorCoolantTemperatureSpeed @ 0x28d44, counterpart: a coolant temperature speed request with its own cold idle timer. CM848 uses a table with hysteresis, park / neutral gating and hot idle timers, and has no ramp-out and no breakpoint floor.

roles.role: Computes the no load fuel: no_load_fuel_quantity (NLFL 0x80db1c) = the coolant temperature friction fuel correction (lookup 0x80db2e at the filtered coolant temperature) + the friction fuel by engine speed (lookup 0x80db20 at ENGRPM).
roles.discriminator: It is the only writer of no_load_fuel_quantity and the only call of cm550_runEvery20FramesTaskSetPhase6.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_calculateNoLoadFuel @ 0x50dba8, counterpart. It is also the only call of cm848_runEvery20FramesTaskSetPhase6, but it sums four terms (adding the A/C clutch and radiator fan adjustments) and stores each one.

roles.role: A single rts. It has one jsr (0x287da) from mc68k_applicationMain's start-up list (step 0x87e0), between cm550_initializeLowSpeedGovernorIdleAdjustment and the undumped 0x4cf42.
roles.discriminator: An empty body. In ROM it directly follows the no load fuel calculation 0x26b3a; the two rts words before it (0x26b7e / 0x26b80) have no references.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none proved. CM848 puts cm848_initInterpolationStateCounters @ 0x50dd10 (the no load fuel lookup caches, also a start-up step) right after cm848_calculateNoLoadFuel. That hints at the same source file's initializer compiled empty in CM550, but an empty body proves nothing.

roles.role: Start-up wrapper: jsr 0x26e8e, then rts. It has one jsr from mc68k_applicationMain (step 0x875c), after cm550_canBusTimingInit and before cm550_initializeEnginePositionSignalInputs.
roles.discriminator: It is the start-up call of 0x26e8e. cm550_runEvery4FramesTaskSetPhase0 runs 0x26e8e every 20 ms after that.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none (see 0x26e8e).

roles.role: Computes the engine speed phase lag lines. ESPG 0x80db64 (e2m 11AA +0) = (ESAVES x ESPGSL >> 4 + ESPGIN + ESCWAJ) / 16. ESPS00PG 0x80db66 (11AA +2) = (ESAVES x ESPSPGSL >> 4 + ESPSPGIN + ESCWAJ) / 16. The inputs are the average engine speed ESAVES 0x80ccf2, the normal and pulse 0 slope / intercept records 0x808476-0x80847c, and ESCWAJ 0x80847e, the one-time TDC adjustment for misaligned cam wheels.
roles.discriminator: It is the only writer of ESPG / ESPS00PG and the only reader of the 11A9 records. It runs in cm550_runEvery4FramesTaskSetPhase0 after cm550_calculateEngineSpeed.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none: the CHR e2m has no 11A9 / 11AA (ESPG / ESCWAJ) records, and the CM848 CSVs have no phase lag.

roles.role: Builds the J1587 PID 243 (component identification) reply for insiteCommandByteDispatcher (insite_parameter_id 0xf3). The reply is [243][data size - 2][MID 0x80][make, 5 bytes][*][model, 17 bytes][*][serial number, 4 raw bytes]. When the data size is at most 19 it is written in place at insite_response_write_pointer. Otherwise it is built at 0x801ade and sent through cm550_insiteMultiFrameResponseBuilder / cm550_insiteMultiFrameContinuation.
roles.discriminator: It is the PID 243 branch of the dispatcher; the sibling branches answer PIDs 234 / 235 / 236 / 237. cm550_buildPgn65259ComponentIdentificationMessage sends the same three records on J1939 (plus a unit number).
roles.cm848_counterpart: none: CM848 has no J1587 / J1708 datalink.

roles.role: Power-down save of the part of the EEPROM image above the refresh window (0x804156-0x804f91). It queues 16-byte pieces through cm550_parameterCircularBufferWrite (source = target address), and after each piece waits up to 16000 x 500 ticks for the queue to drain. If the key input (bit 0 of the CS2 device port 0xffd000) stays set for more than 80 consecutive waits, it calls restartOnKeyOnDuringPowerDown. It stops after two refused pieces in a row; the retry count d4 is never initialised in the function.
roles.discriminator: mc68k_runPowerDownSequence calls it once, after its 1000-pass wait for the queue. The last piece passes (0x804f92 - address) / 2 (a word count) where a byte count is expected, so 0x804f8c-0x804f91 are never queued. It contains no VP44 logic. Its direct read of the chip-select device port makes the prefix mc68k_.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_saveEepromForPowerDown @ 0x539a78, counterpart: the same place in its power-down sequence and the same 80-sample key-on rule. CM848 starts the whole mirror save, restarts only after the save, and then stores the verify retry total, the mirror checksum and the completed power-down count.

roles.role: Copies byte_count bytes from source to the fixed buffer 0x801afc. It increments only the low byte of the source pointer, so the pointer wraps every 256 bytes.
roles.discriminator: Nothing proves a role. The dumped ROM has no call, branch, pointer or pc-relative reference to it, and nothing else references 0x801afc (the RAM dump is 0 there). The callers and the buffer's readers are presumably in the undumped region above 0x40000. 0x801afc is not the J1708 transmit buffer (that is 0x808b00).

roles.role: Applies the J1708 memory write records that cm550_diagnosticMemoryWriteHandler (0x1ec3c) builds at 0x80db68. Each record is 10 bytes: address, data pointer, length, MEMORY_REGION_TYPE. Records of type 3 (AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED) and 5 (EEPROM) are staged in the secure write scratch pad: a directory entry (address / length) at 0x80dd86 + 6n, with the bytes at scratch_pad_write_pointer 0x80ddc2. Other records are copied straight to their address. It returns 14 before copying anything if the pad would exceed 10 entries or the room before the directory; otherwise it returns 0.
